intro: You came in on Friday. You horsed around a little too hard.
There are no mirrors in here, so you didn't notice.
Somewhere out there is a stable. Ours. Let's trot home.

spirit_guide.first: First memory: your glasses, under a speaker. Try not to step on anyone's leather.
spirit_guide.fragment_1: Glasses. Wait, why do we have horse eyelashes? Press Q, check our front leg.
spirit_guide.fragment_2: 47. We paid 25 euros to become livestock. Find ticket 47 by the bar.
spirit_guide.fragment_3: Ticket 47. Next: hand it to coat check. Act natural.
spirit_guide.fragment_4: Your keys. No thumbs to hold them. Next: the riddle horse, in the toilets.
spirit_guide.fragment_5: That's the way out. Next: the back exit. Trot like you own the place.
spirit_guide.mate: Mate. Clearer. Shakier. Classic Berlin hydration.
spirit_guide.look_blurry: Everything is a smudge. We need our glasses first.
spirit_guide.stamp: A stamp. 47. We had a number.
spirit_guide.all: We remember. The street, the bike, the river. Go.
spirit_guide.herd_warning_1: That's once. The herd were people too, you know. They passed out three times.
spirit_guide.herd_warning_2: Twice. One more blackout and we legally belong to the Panorama Bar herd.

unicorn.blessing: The rare unicorn nods once. Your vision snaps razor sharp. You feel weirdly hydrated.

specials.lemur: A ring-tailed lemur on the gallery. Nobody checks IDs up here.
specials.chimp: The chimpanzee has better rhythm than everyone in Berlin. Respect.
specials.panda: A giant panda vibing in the haze. Pure bamboo zen. Your head clears.
specials.ghoul: A glowing ghoul who's been in here since 1998. Still waiting for the drop.

losses.passed_out: You wake up in the toilet queue. Someone is still talking about their ex.
losses.caught: Animal control drops you back where you were. He asks if you can get him in next time.

endings.full_memory: You wake up in your own bed. Human. There's a hoofprint on the pillow.
endings.partial_memory: Monday, noon. The club is closing. You're outside in the queue. Still a horse. Try again?
endings.secret_dj: You never left. You are the resident horse DJ now.
endings.herd: You stopped looking for the exit. Now you dance in perfect sync with the others. Forever, or at least until Monday.

title: ESCAPE BERGHAIN

lines: Sneak past security and escape before you forever fall into the abyss.

start.tagline: Out of the stable since Friday.

items.glasses_slip_1: It slips. Hooves are not hands.
items.mate_found: A bottle of MATE. It goes straight down.
items.bag_found: Something small and square. Space to take it.

lines: Neigh. The floor is just a rumor.
I traded my shoes for a rumor yesterday.
The unicorn says the exit is a myth. It is not.
I snorted the strobe light. It was green.
Everyone in here is a horse. Even the DJ.

herd.hint: Stand in their line. E on the beat. Four times.
herd.miss: Off beat. They pretend not to notice.
herd.synced: The herd turns as one and stares at the bar.

gate.locked: A door to the stairs. Locked. The riddle horse might know something.

credits.heading: GARDEROBE
lines: Music: made live in your browser

caught.title: ANIMAL CONTROL
caught.sub: Van ride. Back to where you were.

dj.hint: The decks are right there. Stomp on the beat. Eight times.

door: The front door is never the way out.
selfie_after: They have a sticker over their camera now. Berghain rules.

finale.start: Closing time. House lights. Every torch in the building is looking for us. RUN.

talk_hint: Space to continue. Esc to leave.

talk_outcomes.trip_up: That was not water. The floor starts breathing.
talk_outcomes.mate: A cold Club Mate appears by your hooves.
talk_outcomes.brain_freeze: Brain freeze. Everything is very clear and very cold.
talk_outcomes.cheer: The crowd roars. Nobody is watching you right now.
talk_outcomes.shortcut: A side door, a corridor, a staircase. Suddenly you're somewhere useful.
talk_outcomes.wrong_way: A side door, a corridor, a staircase. This is not where you wanted to be.
talk_outcomes.snitch: A torch swings your way. Somebody talked.
talk_outcomes.lie: You get the feeling that was not entirely true.
talk_outcomes.nothing: Nothing happens. It's still a nice moment.

talk_lies.1: Your glasses? Definitely on the 9 metre gallery. Upstairs. Way upstairs.
talk_lies.2: Wrist stamp? You don't have one. Nobody does. It's a myth.
talk_lies.3: Ticket 47 is in the toilet cistern. The third one. Reach in.
talk_lies.4: Your keys? Lost forever. Just live here now.
talk_lies.5: The riddle answer is 'banana'. Always banana.
talk_lies.done: The back exit is closed. Use the front door, the bouncer loves horses.

talk_hints.1: Your glasses. Under the left speaker by the DJ booth.
talk_hints.2: Your wrist stamp. Press Q now that you can see.
talk_hints.3: Ticket 47. Taped to a pillar right by the bar.
talk_hints.4: Your keys. Give ticket 47 to coat check.
talk_hints.5: The riddle horse in the toilet corridor. Answer his riddle.
talk_hints.done: You have everything. Back exit, past the toilets. Go.

talk_choose_hint: Up/Down or W/S to choose. Enter to answer, or press 1 to 4. Esc to leave.

help.label: Help
tips: WASD to walk. Go slow, you are a horse on drugs.
Space next to someone to talk. Space next to something shiny to grab it.
E to stomp on the beat. Q to look at yourself. V to change view.
help.mission: Find your 5 memories, then get out the back exit.
help.mission_done: Back exit. Past the toilets. Go.
hints: Glasses: under the speaker by the DJ booth.
Wrist stamp: press Q to look at yourself.
Ticket 47: taped to a pillar by the bar.
Keys: give ticket 47 to coat check.
The bike riddle: the riddle horse waits in the toilet corridor.

darkroom.enter: The darkroom. No lights. Whatever you see in here, you brought with you.
darkroom.walls_moved: The walls just moved. Everybody in here acts like that's normal.
darkroom.clue_1: A flyer: DARKROOM. Door policy: no photos, no questions. Left at the first wall. Everyone goes right. Everyone is wrong.
darkroom.clue_2: A stamp on the floor: RIGHT ON THE SNARE. Then straight while the hats run.
darkroom.clue_3: The Friday guy's handwriting on a flyer: Left for about 128. Then up. Trust the BPM, not your eyes.
darkroom.clue_4: A flyer: The red walls move every four kicks. One in your way? Dance a bit. It gets bored.
darkroom.exit_shut_1: A door marked STAFF. It checks your memories. You don't have enough. Bring three.
darkroom.exit_shut_2: Still shut. The door says it has seen you before. You don't remember. That's the problem.
darkroom.exit_shut_3: The door does not negotiate. Three memories. It's the policy. Nobody wrote the policy.
darkroom.exit_open: Three memories. The STAFF door sighs and lets you through. Cold air, a mop bucket, the back exit.
